2609.11786.title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Switch Aware Evaluation of ASR and Audio Language Models on English Yoruba Code-Switched Speech
2609.11786.paper_summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems and audio language models (audio LMs) now report low error rates on monolingual benchmarks, but their behavior on code switched speech in low resource, diacritic rich languages remains poorly characterized. We present a switch aware evaluation of eleven modern systems (six ASR models and five audio LMs) on English Yoruba code-switched speech, using a deterministic 2000 utterance evaluation set and a shared scoring pipeline. Beyond word error rate (WER), we report switch localized diagnostics: a switch entry token error rate (SETER), windowed switch point error rates, language specific error rates, and a diacritic insensitive WER. Our central finding is that aggregate WER hides code switching behavior. The best system by WER (an ASR model) is statistically indistinguishable from a leading audio LM on WER, yet the audio LM is significantly better on every switch localized metric. Across faithful systems, Yoruba token recognition collapses (error 0.97 for almost all systems) while English tokens are recognized far better, and errors concentrate sharply at switches into Yoruba. Several generative audio LMs fail as exact transcribers, producing translation, verbosity, and prompt leakage that are strongly prompt dependent. We release manifests, metric implementations, and evaluation scripts to support reproducible, switch aware benchmarking for African code switched speech.
2609.11786.paper_summary_zh: 自動語音識別（ASR）系統和音頻語言模型（音頻 LM）在單語基準上報告了低錯誤率，但它們在低資源、帶有變音符號的語言中的代碼切換語音行為仍然缺乏充分的特徵描述。我們針對英語-約魯巴語代碼切換語音，對十一個現代系統（六個 ASR 模型和五個音頻 LM）進行了切換感知評估，使用了一個確定性的 2000 句話評估集和共享的計分管道。除了單詞錯誤率（WER）之外，我們報告了切換本地化診斷：切換進入標記錯誤率（SETER）、窗口切換點錯誤率、語言特定錯誤率以及對變音符號不敏感的 WER。我們的主要發現是，總體 WER 隱藏了代碼切換行為。在 WER 上表現最佳的系統（ASR 模型）在統計上與領先的音頻 LM 無法區分，但在每個切換本地化指標上，音頻 LM 的表現卻顯著更好。在忠實系統中，約魯巴語標記的識別崩潰（幾乎所有系統的錯誤率為 0.97），而英語標記的識別則好得多，錯誤在切換到約魯巴語時急劇集中。幾個生成音頻 LM 作為精確的轉錄者失敗，產生的翻譯、冗長性和提示洩漏強烈依賴於提示。我們發布了清單、度量實現和評估腳本，以支持可重現的、切換感知的非洲代碼切換語音基準測試。
